datasets.name: IEAccountList
datasets.sql:
select* from (
SELECT
   id,Acc_No||'  '||Name Acc_No,Val_Acc,Name,FILIAL,bal_cn1
  FROM ACCOUNT
 WHERE (bal_cn1 IN (SELECT accountnumber
                           FROM smart.cm_aginfo
                          WHERE groupid = (SELECT g.id
                                             FROM smart.cm_accountgroups g
                                            WHERE g.iname = 'IncExpAccounts')))
and (Close_Dat is Null) and FILIAL in (select id from sb_filial)
and FILIAL in(select id from filial)
union all

SELECT
   id,Acc_No||'  '||Name Acc_No,Val_Acc,Name,FILIAL,bal_cn1
  FROM out_ACCOUNT
 WHERE (bal_cn1 IN (SELECT accountnumber
                           FROM smart.cm_aginfo
                          WHERE groupid = (SELECT g.id
                                             FROM smart.cm_accountgroups g
                                            WHERE g.iname = 'IncExpAccounts')))
and (Close_Dat is Null) and FILIAL in (select id from sb_filial)
and FILIAL in(select id from filial))

datasets.name: LinksData
datasets.sql:
SELECT id, categoryid, description
   FROM smart.cm_links
 where categoryid = :categoryid
ORDER BY id

datasets.name: LinkValuesData
datasets.sql:
SELECT l.RowID,
       l.linkid, 
       l.branchid, 
       l.currencyid, 
       l.accountid,
       l.MEHSULID,m.name
  FROM smart.cm_link_values l ,cm_mehsul_links_settings m
  where  l.mehsulid=m.id(+) and linkid = :linkid
ORDER BY l.branchid,l.currencyid
